source_title: “Every girl deserves a shot at her dreams”: Caitlin Clark foundation gets $22,000 grant as WNBA star's of - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Caitlin Clark continues to build her impact beyond basketball. The Indiana Fever star's foundation received a special $22,000 grant through the 2025 Gainbridge Assists programme, joining a group of organisations working to create more opportunities for girls and women. The announcement also brought together tennis legend Billie Jean King and several grassroots initiatives, with a total of $222,000 in funding announced for the programme.Gainbridge, Parity and the Women's Sports Foundation announced the recipients on September 4, 2025. Now in its third year, the initiative supports projects that use sports and education to help the next generation. Clark's foundation received special recognition for its work with young people. Billie Jean King-led initiative recognises 32 organisations with $222,000 in grantsThe third annual Gainbridge Assists programme distributed funding across 21 states. Each of the 32 recipients was set to receive $5,000 for an event or project supporting girls and women in sports or education. The list included grassroots organisations, elite athletes, Olympians, Paralympians and student-led nonprofits.The programme also announced a special $50,000 grant for the Turnstone Center for Children and Adults with Disabilities. The Caitlin Clark Foundation received another special grant of $22,000, recognising its work to uplift young people through education, nutrition and sports.Mike Nichols, Group 1001's chief of sponsorship strategy and activation, explained the purpose behind the initiative in the September 4 announcement."Gainbridge Assists continues to grow in reach and resonance levels, supporting changemakers who are breaking down barriers and fostering participation and leadership," Nichols said.He added, "The impact goes far beyond the numbers. It's about investing in equity, access, and the belief that every girl deserves a shot at her dreams."The programme also honours Billie Jean King's contribution to women's sports. The tennis legend founded the Women's Sports Foundation more than 50 years ago with a $5,000 cheque. She welcomed the latest group of recipients and highlighted the opportunities their work could create."This is an opportunity for each of the organizations to make a huge difference for the next generation of girls and women," King said in the September 4 announcement. She also praised Gainbridge for supporting women's sports, particularly at the grassroots level. Why Caitlin Clark's foundation received a special $22,000 grantWhile the regular recipients received $5,000 each, Clark's foundation earned a separate $22,000 grant for its work across three areas: education, nutrition and sports. These pillars form the centre of the organisation's mission to improve the lives of young people and their communities.The foundation's approach also reflects Clark's own belief about the opportunities that helped shape her career. Its work goes beyond basketball, focusing on giving children access to resources and experiences that can help them learn, grow and stay active.Clark previously spoke about the foundation's purpose when Gainbridge presented it with another $22,000 grant during the 2024 Parity Week programme. Speaking about the partnership in the November 18, 2024 announcement, the WNBA star said, "The Caitlin Clark Foundation aims to improve the lives of youth through three pillars - education, nutrition, and sports. This aligns with Gainbridge really well."She also expressed gratitude for the support, adding, "They definitely caught me by surprise with this grant and I'm thankful to be part of their team."The 2025 programme asked recipients to carry out their funded events and projects in November 2025. For Clark, the latest recognition added to the foundation's work away from the Indiana Fever court. Her basketball career continues to put her in the spotlight, but the organisation gives her another way to support young people and expand opportunities beyond the game.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
